titleEn: Count Number of Rectangles Containing Each Point
title: 统计包含每个点的矩形数目
summary: 矩形左下角为原点、右上角给定，统计每个点被多少矩形包含。矩形高度不超过一百。
insight: 按高度分桶存矩形宽度并排序。对点 (x,y)，只遍历高度 y 到一百的桶，二分第一个宽度不小于 x，桶后缀数量都包含该点。
pitfalls: 返回顺序与 points 一致

solutions.title: 高度分桶与宽度二分
solutions.idea: 利用小高度范围把二维支配查询降为多次一维查询。
steps: buckets[101] 收集每个 rectangle width，按桶排序
对 point 初始化 count=0
height 从 point.y 到 100，在桶中 lower_bound(point.x)，累加 size-index

code.java: class Solution { public int[] countRectangles(int[][] rectangles,int[][] points){List<Integer>[] widths=new List[101];for(int i=0;i<=100;i++)widths[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] rectangle:rectangles)widths[rectangle[1]].add(rectangle[0]);for(List<Integer> bucket:widths)Collections.sort(bucket);int[] answer=new int[points.length];for(int p=0;p<points.length;p++)for(int height=points[p][1];height<=100;height++){List<Integer> bucket=widths[height];int left=0,right=bucket.size();while(left<right){int middle=(left+right)/2;if(bucket.get(middle)<points[p][0])left=middle+1;else right=middle;}answer[p]+=bucket.size()-left;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countRectangles(rectangles:Array<IntArray>,points:Array<IntArray>):IntArray{val widths=Array(101){mutableListOf<Int>()};for(rectangle in rectangles)widths[rectangle[1]].add(rectangle[0]);for(bucket in widths)bucket.sort();return IntArray(points.size){p->var answer=0;for(height in points[p][1]..100){val bucket=widths[height];var left=0;var right=bucket.size;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right)/2;if(bucket[middle]<points[p][0])left=middle+1 else right=middle};answer+=bucket.size-left};answer}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> countRectangles(vector<vector<int>>& rectangles,vector<vector<int>>& points){vector<vector<int>> widths(101);for(auto& rectangle:rectangles)widths[rectangle[1]].push_back(rectangle[0]);for(auto& bucket:widths)sort(bucket.begin(),bucket.end());vector<int> answer;for(auto& point:points){int count=0;for(int height=point[1];height<=100;++height){auto& bucket=widths[height];count+=bucket.end()-lower_bound(bucket.begin(),bucket.end(),point[0]);}answer.push_back(count);}return answer;} };
